description: Queue an AI analysis of completed interviews into a cited report (findings, themes, quotes). Clients that support MCP background tasks receive a task to wait on; other clients receive a job ID and poll get_report_job. Then call get_study_report. report.ready webhooks also signal completion.

idempotency_key.description: Reuse the same key and inputs if a prior call timed out. A different operation needs a new key.

organization_id.description: Organization for this operation and billing. Use list_organizations to choose an active membership.

study_id.description: UUID of the study, as returned by list_studies.

name: generate_report
title: Generate Study Report
